testCase.name: Build Cache Corruption
testCase.description: Gradle build cache corrupted causing build failures

error.message: Execution failed for task :app:compileDebugKotlin. Compilation error

metadata.context: Intermittent build failures, works after clean

agent_response.rootCause: The compilation error in app:compileDebugKotlin is due to an incompatible AGP version with Gradle. The current AGP version (8.1.0) does not support the current Gradle version (8.9). Older AGP versions require a lower Gradle version, specifically up to 8.2.
fixGuidelines: Update AGP version in gradle/libs.versions.toml at line 8 from 8.1.0 to 8.7.3.
Verify the fix by rebuilding the project using ./gradlew clean build.
